c8db402cba.q: What did Quraysh say to ʿAbd al-Muttalib when Zamzam appeared to him?
c: “It is the well of our father Ismaʿil, so give us a share in it with you”
“It is a cursed well, so bury it”
c8db402cba.e: Quraysh said: “ʿAbd al-Muttalib, it is the well of our father Ismaʿil and we have a right in it, so give us a share in it with you.”

d72176f252.q: To whom did Quraysh agree to take their dispute with ʿAbd al-Muttalib over Zamzam?
c: The soothsayer-woman of Banu Saʿd Hudhaym
d72176f252.e: Quraysh told ʿAbd al-Muttalib: “We will take our case against you to the soothsayer-woman of Banu Saʿd Hudhaym.”

bf61d0a5b6.q: Who was the woman of Banu Saʿd who nursed the Prophet ﷺ?
bf61d0a5b6.e: Halima bint Abi Dhuʾayb al-Saʿdiyya was the foster mother who nursed the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.

605a59fc1e.q: From which tribe were the women with whom Halima went out looking for infants to nurse?
605a59fc1e.e: Halima went out with her husband and son among women of Banu Saʿd ibn Bakr looking for infants to nurse.

47d5b4d179.q: Who nursed the Prophet ﷺ before Halima?
47d5b4d179.e: Thuwayba nursed him ﷺ before Halima, and also nursed his uncle Hamza.

9b22e86996.q: How old was the Prophet ﷺ when his mother Amina died?
9b22e86996.e: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was six, his mother Amina bint Wahb died.

f60cfaf2b2.q: Where did Amina bint Wahb, the Prophet's mother ﷺ, die?
c: At al-Abwaʾ, between Makkah and Madinah
f60cfaf2b2.e: Amina died, when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was six, at al-Abwaʾ between Makkah and Madinah, on the way back from visiting his maternal relatives.

298ddcaa43.q: Who were the Prophet's ﷺ maternal relatives whom his mother took him to visit before she died?
298ddcaa43.e: Amina had brought him to his maternal relatives of Banu ʿAdi ibn al-Najjar to visit them, and she died on the way back.

eb3519bdf3.q: How old was the Prophet ﷺ when his grandfather ʿAbd al-Muttalib died?
eb3519bdf3.e: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was eight, ʿAbd al-Muttalib died - eight years after the Elephant.

f6914364fd.q: What would ʿAbd al-Muttalib say when the Prophet's ﷺ uncles wanted to move him off his rug?
c: “Leave my son - by Allah, he has a great future”
“He is an orphan, be gentle with him”
f6914364fd.e: ʿAbd al-Muttalib would say: “Leave my son - by Allah, he has a great future,” then sit him beside him on the rug.

1ae299c578.q: Who looked after the Prophet ﷺ after his grandfather ʿAbd al-Muttalib died?
1ae299c578.e: After ʿAbd al-Muttalib, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ lived with his uncle Abu Talib, to whom ʿAbd al-Muttalib had entrusted him.

e55edec58a.q: Why did ʿAbd al-Muttalib entrust the Prophet ﷺ to Abu Talib rather than another son?
c: Because ʿAbd Allah and Abu Talib had the same father and mother
Because he was his eldest son
Because he was the richest of them
e55edec58a.e: ʿAbd Allah, the father of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and Abu Talib were full brothers; their mother was Fatima bint ʿAmr ibn ʿAʾidh.

07f4f7a76d.q: What was the name of the monk the Prophet ﷺ met with his uncle Abu Talib at Bostra?
07f4f7a76d.e: The caravan stopped at Bostra in Syria, where there was a monk called Bahira in his cell.

3dc283bd0a.q: What did Bahira advise Abu Talib about his nephew?
c: To take him back home and guard him against the Jews
To leave him with him in the cell
3dc283bd0a.e: Bahira said to Abu Talib: “Take your nephew back to his land, and guard him against the Jews.”

92f0c1bf03.q: How old was the Prophet ﷺ when he married Khadija, may Allah be pleased with her?
92f0c1bf03.e: Ibn Hisham said: when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was twenty-five he married Khadija bint Khuwaylid.

1a8dc102dc.q: By what name was Khadija, may Allah be pleased with her, known before and after Islam?
1a8dc102dc.e: Khadija bint Khuwaylid was called al-Tahira before Islam and in Islam.

663889e549.q: What was the name of Khadija's servant who went with the Prophet ﷺ on her trading journey to Syria?
663889e549.e: Khadija offered the Prophet ﷺ to take her goods to Syria with a servant of hers called Maysara.

8505dcddfd.q: What did the monk tell Maysara about the man who rested under the tree?
c: “No one has ever rested under this tree but a prophet”
“This man is from the people of the Haram”
8505dcddfd.e: The monk told Maysara: “No one has ever rested under this tree but a prophet.”

09c554de04.q: Who was the eldest daughter of the Prophet ﷺ according to Ibn Hisham?
09c554de04.e: Ibn Hisham said: the eldest of his daughters was Ruqayya, then Zaynab, then Umm Kulthum, then Fatima. (The biographers differ on this.)

a4fbc93922.q: Who was the mother of Ibrahim, the Prophet's ﷺ son?
a4fbc93922.e: Ibn Hisham said: as for Ibrahim, his mother was Mariya the Copt, sent as a gift by al-Muqawqis.

6431e995eb.q: Who sent Mariya the Copt as a gift to the Prophet ﷺ?
6431e995eb.e: Mariya was the Prophet's ﷺ concubine whom al-Muqawqis sent to him as a gift.

d987df2f98.q: Which cousin of Khadija said, “Muhammad is the prophet of this nation”?
d987df2f98.e: When Khadija told her cousin Waraqa ibn Nawfal what Maysara had said, he said: “If this is true, Khadija, Muhammad is the prophet of this nation.”

5711ee9b92.q: How old was the Prophet ﷺ when Quraysh gathered to rebuild the Kaʿba?
5711ee9b92.e: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was thirty-five, Quraysh gathered to rebuild the Kaʿba.

61c166cbbc.q: What did Abu Wahb ibn ʿAmr tell Quraysh when they wanted to rebuild the Kaʿba?
c: “Put nothing into its building from your earnings but what is pure”
61c166cbbc.e: Abu Wahb said: “O Quraysh, put nothing into its building from your earnings but what is pure - no harlot's fee, no usurious sale.”

83d3c8ed0b.q: What did Quraysh call the Prophet ﷺ before revelation came to him?
83d3c8ed0b.e: Before revelation came to him, Quraysh called the Messenger of Allah ﷺ al-Amin.

6f79b3208f.q: How old was the Prophet ﷺ when Allah sent him as a prophet?
6f79b3208f.e: When Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, was forty, Allah the Exalted sent him as a mercy to the worlds.

91835344cc.q: What was the first form of revelation that came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?
c: Jibril coming down in the cave
91835344cc.e: ʿAʾisha, may Allah be pleased with her, said: the first sign of prophethood that came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was true dreams.

47dc5926c4.q: In which cave did the Truth come to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ?
47dc5926c4.e: In ʿAʾisha's hadith: until the Truth came to him while he was in the Cave of Hiraʾ, and Jibril came to him.

43978127ef.q: Where did Waraqa ibn Nawfal meet the Prophet ﷺ after he left his retreat?
c: While he was circling the Kaʿba
43978127ef.e: When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ finished his retreat he went first to the Kaʿba and circled it, and Waraqa ibn Nawfal met him while he was circling.

0f2a48021f.q: Which of these became Muslim through Abu Bakr's call, may Allah be pleased with him?
0f2a48021f.e: Through Abu Bakr's call - as Ibn Ishaq heard - ʿUthman ibn ʿAffan, al-Zubayr, ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn ʿAwf, Saʿd and Talha became Muslim.

6a0cda47ae.q: What was Abu Bakr known for among his people, as Ibn Ishaq describes?
c: He knew the lineages of Quraysh better than anyone
He was the finest poet of Quraysh
He was the richest man of Quraysh
He was the soothsayer of Quraysh
6a0cda47ae.e: Abu Bakr was a man his people warmed to, well loved and easy-going, and he knew the lineages and history of Quraysh better than anyone.

f16657ce6a.q: What was the name of Abu Waqqas, Saʿd's father, as Ibn Ishaq gives it?
f16657ce6a.e: Ibn Ishaq said: and Saʿd ibn Abi Waqqas - Abu Waqqas's name was Malik ibn Uhayb.

d4b2cc79fa.q: What was the name of Abu ʿUbayda ibn al-Jarrah?
d4b2cc79fa.e: Abu ʿUbayda ibn al-Jarrah became Muslim; his name was ʿAmir ibn ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Jarrah.

9fb4463996.q: According to Ibn Ishaq, how many were in the group that preceded everyone in Islam?
9fb4463996.e: Ibn Ishaq said: these eight were the ones who preceded the people in Islam, praying and believing.

381b79a310.q: What was the name of Abu Salama, who became Muslim early?
381b79a310.e: Ibn Ishaq said: and Abu Salama, whose name was ʿAbd Allah ibn ʿAbd al-Asad.

59462954c1.q: Which two daughters of Abu Bakr are named among the first Muslims?
59462954c1.e: Ibn Ishaq names among the first Muslims Asmaʾ bint Abi Bakr and ʿAʾisha bint Abi Bakr, who was then small.

4840cb7678.q: Of whom is the proverb said: “Whoever shoots at al-Qara has treated them fairly”?
c: Al-Qara, who were a people of archers
4840cb7678.e: Ibn Hisham said: al-Qara is a nickname, and of them it is said “whoever shoots at al-Qara has treated them fairly”; they were a people of archers.

727d629279.q: Who was the wife of Jaʿfar ibn Abi Talib who became Muslim with him early on?
727d629279.e: Ibn Ishaq names among the first Muslims Jaʿfar ibn Abi Talib and his wife Asmaʾ bint ʿUmays.

573548f02b.e: Ibn Hisham said: ʿAmir ibn Fuhayra was a black man whom Abu Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, bought.

e4b779cca4.q: What was Abu Jahl's name, and what kunya was he known by?
c: Al-Walid, known as Abu ʿAbd Shams
e4b779cca4.e: Ibn Ishaq said: and Abu Jahl, whose name was ʿAmr; he was known as Abu al-Hakam ibn Hisham.

08e95d7781.q: What did the delegation of Quraysh ask of Abu Talib concerning the Prophet ﷺ?
c: That he stop him or stand aside and leave him to them
That he marry him to one of their daughters
That he send him out of Makkah to Taʾif
That he pay them his blood-money
08e95d7781.e: The Quraysh delegation said: “Abu Talib, your nephew has insulted our gods … either stop him, or stand aside and leave him to us.”

dfd2c1f6ae.q: What did Waraqa ibn Nawfal tell Khadija when she told him what had happened to the Prophet ﷺ?
c: “The great Namus (Jibril) who came to Musa has come to him”
dfd2c1f6ae.e: Waraqa said: “If you have told me the truth, Khadija, the great Namus who used to come to Musa has come to him, and he is the prophet of this nation.”

024158e656.q: Through whom did Allah protect His Messenger ﷺ from Quraysh when the clans turned on the Muslims?
024158e656.e: Every clan turned on the Muslims among them, and Allah protected His Messenger ﷺ from them through his uncle Abu Talib.

b52fa2ab13.q: Who among Banu Hashim and Banu al-Muttalib refused Abu Talib's call to protect the Prophet ﷺ?
b52fa2ab13.e: Banu Hashim and Banu al-Muttalib gathered to Abu Talib and agreed to protect the Messenger of Allah ﷺ - except Abu Lahab.

c013c2f59f.q: About whom was the verse revealed: “Leave Me with the one I created alone”?
c013c2f59f.e: Allah the Exalted revealed about al-Walid ibn al-Mughira: “Leave Me with the one I created alone…” (meaning)

ede7615e64.q: On al-Walid's advice, what did Quraysh agree to call the Prophet ﷺ to the people at the season of pilgrimage?
c: A sorcerer whose words divide a man from his family
ede7615e64.e: Al-Walid said: “The closest thing to say of him is that he is a sorcerer who brings words of sorcery that divide a man from his son, his brother and his wife.”

8ce3d50b5d.q: What did Quraysh realise when Hamza, may Allah be pleased with him, became Muslim?
c: That the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had become strong and protected
That Banu Hashim would fight them
That they had to leave Makkah
8ce3d50b5d.e: When Hamza became Muslim, Quraysh knew that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ had become strong and protected, and they held back from some of what they had been doing to him.

d71ca85eee.q: Who went to the Prophet ﷺ to offer him things, hoping he would accept some and leave them alone?
d71ca85eee.e: ʿUtba ibn Rabiʿa said: “O Quraysh, shall I not go to Muhammad, speak to him and offer him things he might accept?”

d7ad6b4012.q: What did ʿUtba ibn Rabiʿa tell Quraysh after he had listened to the Prophet ﷺ?
c: “By Allah, it is not poetry, nor sorcery, nor soothsaying”
d7ad6b4012.e: ʿUtba said: “I have heard words the like of which I have never heard. By Allah, it is not poetry, nor sorcery, nor soothsaying.”

681151c02f.q: How did Quraysh answer ʿUtba's opinion about the Prophet ﷺ?
c: “By Allah, Abu al-Walid, he has bewitched you with his tongue”
“We will give him what he wants”
681151c02f.e: Quraysh told ʿUtba: “By Allah, Abu al-Walid, he has bewitched you with his tongue.”

7cc6cb0b15.q: In the story of the People of the Cave, what does “al-Raqim” mean according to Ibn Hisham?
c: The writing in which their story was inscribed
7cc6cb0b15.e: Ibn Hisham said: al-Raqim is the writing in which their story was inscribed; its plural is ruqum.

2306df579b.q: Who spoke to the Negus on behalf of the Muslims who emigrated to Abyssinia?
2306df579b.e: Umm Salama said: the one who spoke to the Negus was Jaʿfar ibn Abi Talib.

700494da44.q: How did Jaʿfar begin describing the Arabs' condition to the Negus?
c: “We were a people of ignorance, worshipping idols”
“We were the richest of the Arabs”
700494da44.e: Jaʿfar said: “O King, we were a people of ignorance, worshipping idols and eating carrion … until Allah sent us a messenger from among ourselves.”

279726562d.q: Who came running to give the Muslims in Abyssinia the good news that the Negus had defeated his enemy?
279726562d.e: Umm Salama said: al-Zubayr appeared running, waving his garment and saying: “Good news! The Negus has won.”

5ec45ae3b2.q: Which sister of ʿUmar ibn al-Khattab had become Muslim with her husband?
5ec45ae3b2.e: ʿUmar's sister Fatima bint al-Khattab was married to Saʿid ibn Zayd; she and her husband had become Muslim, hiding it from ʿUmar.

87e7a260e3.q: Who used to visit Fatima bint al-Khattab to teach her the Qurʾan?
87e7a260e3.e: Khabbab ibn al-Aratt used to visit Fatima bint al-Khattab to teach her the Qurʾan.

689da61b65.q: What did the Prophet ﷺ do when ʿUmar said, “I have come to believe in Allah and His Messenger”?
c: He said “Allahu akbar” so that the household knew ʿUmar had become Muslim
He took him to the Kaʿba at once
He sent him to Abu Bakr
689da61b65.e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said “Allahu akbar” so loudly that his Companions in the house knew ʿUmar had become Muslim.

a921f35264.q: Which wife was a “true supporter in Islam” to the Prophet ﷺ, whose death brought him one sorrow after another?
a921f35264.e: Sorrows came one after another upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with the death of Khadija, who had been a true supporter in Islam, and the death of his uncle Abu Talib.

398e23c55c.q: When did Abu Talib and Khadija die, relative to the Prophet's ﷺ Hijra?
398e23c55c.e: Khadija and Abu Talib died three years before he ﷺ emigrated to Madinah.

27517259b3.q: What did the Prophet ﷺ say to his daughter as she washed the dust from his head, weeping?
c: “Do not weep, my little daughter; Allah will protect your father”
27517259b3.e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to his daughter: “Do not weep, my little daughter; Allah will protect your father.”

4c4dcb5bf3.q: What did the Prophet ﷺ hope for from his uncle Abu Talib as he was dying?
c: That he would say it, so he could intercede for him on the Day of Resurrection
That he would commend him to Quraysh
That he would go with him to Madinah
That he would give him his wealth
4c4dcb5bf3.e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Uncle, say it, so that I may be able to intercede for you by it on the Day of Resurrection.”

8308a1db6b.q: How many men of the Khazraj first met the Prophet ﷺ and believed?
8308a1db6b.e: Ibn Ishaq said: they were, as I was told, six men of the Khazraj.

6b78d824ae.q: What did the men of the Khazraj say to one another when the Prophet ﷺ invited them to Islam?
c: “He is the prophet the Jews warned you of - do not let them reach him before you”
“He is a sorcerer, beware of him”
“A man of Quraysh we do not know”
“Let us see what his people say”
6b78d824ae.e: They said to one another: “Know, by Allah, that he is the prophet the Jews have warned you of; do not let them reach him before you.”

d7067b72a3.q: How many leaders (naqibs) did the Prophet ﷺ ask the Ansar for at the Pledge of ʿAqaba?
d7067b72a3.e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “Bring out twelve leaders from among you,” and they brought out nine from the Khazraj and three from the Aws.

96e8547957.q: How many of the leaders at the Pledge of ʿAqaba were from the Aws?
96e8547957.e: The Ansar brought out twelve leaders: nine from the Khazraj and three from the Aws.

7e94e1d3a3.q: How did the Prophet ﷺ answer Abu al-Haytham ibn al-Tayyihan when he feared he would return to his people and leave them?
c: “No - blood for blood, ruin for ruin; I am of you and you are of me”
“I will return to Makkah if Allah opens it”
“The matter is Allah's, He places it where He wills”
7e94e1d3a3.e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ smiled, then said: “No - blood for blood, ruin for ruin; I am of you and you are of me.”

ed062eec52.q: Who was the first of the Muhajirun to arrive in Madinah after Abu Salama?
ed062eec52.e: Ibn Ishaq said: the first of the Muhajirun to arrive after Abu Salama was ʿAmir ibn Rabiʿa, with his wife Layla bint Abi Hathma.

f579bfab63.q: Which of the Muhajirun was blind yet went all over Makkah, high and low, without a guide?
f579bfab63.e: Abu Ahmad ibn Jahsh was blind, and he went all over Makkah, high and low, without a guide; he was a poet.

6b0295f675.q: What plan did Abu Jahl propose at Dar al-Nadwa to kill the Prophet ﷺ?
c: To take a young man from every clan to strike him as one man
To lock him in a house until he died
6b0295f675.e: Abu Jahl said: “I think we should take from every clan a strong young man … and they strike him as one man, so that his blood is spread among the clans.”

d830b23f91.q: Who pursued the Prophet ﷺ and Abu Bakr during the Hijra, with his horse stumbling under him?
d830b23f91.e: Suraqa said: my horse stumbled with me … so I called to them: “I am Suraqa ibn Juʿshum, wait for me so I can speak with you.”

aa5f498fc1.q: Where did Suraqa meet the Prophet ﷺ, carrying the letter Abu Bakr had written for him?
c: In Makkah on the day of the Conquest
aa5f498fc1.e: After the Conquest, Hunayn and Taʾif, Suraqa went out with the letter and met the Messenger of Allah ﷺ at al-Jiʿrana.

eb88aa523d.q: Where did the Prophet ﷺ found his mosque on his arrival, before entering Madinah?
eb88aa523d.e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ stayed at Quba among Banu ʿAmr ibn ʿAwf on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, and founded his mosque.

26ed627f4c.q: Which Companion broke his people's idols at night and gave them to a woman in Quba for firewood?
26ed627f4c.e: The woman told ʿAli: “This is Sahl ibn Hunayf; at nightfall he goes for his people's idols, breaks them and brings them to me, saying: use this for firewood.”

6e4ef495d5.q: Whose hand did the Prophet ﷺ take at the brotherhood pact, saying, “This is my brother”?
6e4ef495d5.e: He ﷺ said: “Become brothers in Allah, two by two,” then took ʿAli ibn Abi Talib's hand and said: “This is my brother.”

3d5f922cdf.q: Whom did the Prophet ﷺ make the brother of Hamza ibn ʿAbd al-Muttalib?
3d5f922cdf.e: Hamza ibn ʿAbd al-Muttalib and Zayd ibn Haritha, the freedman of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, were made brothers.

71d09f1a8d.q: Who was Jaʿfar ibn Abi Talib's brother in the brotherhood pact?
71d09f1a8d.e: Ibn Ishaq said: Jaʿfar ibn Abi Talib, the one with two wings, and Muʿadh ibn Jabal of Banu Salima were made brothers.

9d1ec23b3e.q: Who was Abu Bakr al-Siddiq's brother in the brotherhood pact?
9d1ec23b3e.e: Ibn Ishaq said: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq and Kharija ibn Zuhayr of Banu al-Harith ibn al-Khazraj were made brothers.

963db5cc03.q: Where was ʿAbd Allah ibn Salam when news of the Prophet's ﷺ arrival reached him?
c: At the top of one of his palm trees, working on it
In the market of Banu Qaynuqaʿ
963db5cc03.e: ʿAbd Allah ibn Salam said: a man came and told of his arrival while I was at the top of a palm tree of mine, working on it, with my aunt Khalida sitting below.

cee8a06a9e.q: How did ʿAbd Allah ibn Salam answer his aunt when she objected to his “Allahu akbar” at the Prophet's ﷺ arrival?
c: “By Allah, he is the brother of Musa son of ʿImran and follows his religion”
“He is an Arab we do not know”
cee8a06a9e.e: He said to his aunt: “Aunt, by Allah, he is the brother of Musa son of ʿImran and follows his religion; he was sent with what Musa was sent with.”

12c3ced5ee.q: Who carried the banner of the Ansar at Badr, according to Ibn Hisham?
12c3ced5ee.e: The banner of the Ansar was with Saʿd ibn Muʿadh, according to Ibn Hisham.

a6b2062855.q: Whom did the Prophet ﷺ put in charge of the rearguard on the march to Badr?
a6b2062855.e: Ibn Ishaq said: he put Qays ibn Abi Saʿsaʿa of Banu Mazin ibn al-Najjar over the rearguard.

c291e62e4a.q: How did Abu Sufyan know that the Muslims' scouts had come to the water of Badr?
c: He crumbled their camels' dung and found date stones in it
He heard the two slave-girls arguing
c291e62e4a.e: Abu Sufyan went to where their camels had knelt, crumbled some dung and found date stones in it, and said: “By Allah, this is the fodder of Yathrib.”

0210449e39.q: Who were the two men the Prophet ﷺ sent, who came down to Badr and heard news of the caravan?
c: Basbas ibn ʿAmr and ʿAdi ibn Abi al-Zaghbaʾ
Majdi ibn ʿAmr and Salama ibn Salama
0210449e39.e: Basbas ibn ʿAmr and ʿAdi ibn Abi al-Zaghbaʾ went on to Badr, heard the two slave-girls, and returned to tell the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.

15e5f6c117.q: Who advised the Prophet ﷺ at Badr to camp at the water nearest the enemy?
15e5f6c117.e: Al-Hubab ibn al-Mundhir said: “Lead the people on until we reach the water nearest the enemy and camp there,” and he ﷺ said: “You have given good counsel.”

efab050d2d.q: What did Saʿd ibn Muʿadh offer the Prophet ﷺ at Badr?
c: To build him a shelter to stay in
To fight in the front line
To send a messenger to Quraysh
efab050d2d.e: Saʿd ibn Muʿadh said: “Prophet of Allah, shall we not build you a shelter to stay in, and keep your mounts ready beside you?”

11578e5e6c.q: How did the Prophet ﷺ answer al-Hubab's question: “Is this a place Allah has given you, or is it opinion?”
c: “No, it is opinion, war and strategy”
“No, it is a place Allah has given me”
“It is what the people agreed on”
11578e5e6c.e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ told al-Hubab: “No, it is opinion, war and strategy.”

ee77be50a9.q: By what name did Umayya ibn Khalaf agree to call ʿAbd al-Rahman ibn ʿAwf?
ee77be50a9.e: Umayya said: “Then you are ʿAbd al-Ilah,” and whenever he passed him he would call “ʿAbd al-Ilah!” and he would answer.

222510d262.q: Who cut off Abu Jahl's head and brought it to the Prophet ﷺ at Badr?
222510d262.e: Abu Jahl said to Ibn Masʿud: “You have climbed a hard climb, little shepherd,” then Ibn Masʿud cut off his head and brought it to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.

6ba6f8598e.q: What did the Prophet ﷺ tell his Companions when he shared out the captives of Badr among them?
6ba6f8598e.e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ shared the captives among his Companions and said: “Treat the captives well.”

350aaacbfe.q: Which captive at Badr was the full brother of Musʿab ibn ʿUmayr?
350aaacbfe.e: Abu ʿAziz ibn ʿUmayr, Musʿab ibn ʿUmayr's full brother, was among the captives of Badr.

db3d8e7a9c.q: Which captive of Badr did Sawda see with his hands tied to his neck, so that she said: “Why did you not die nobly?”
db3d8e7a9c.e: Sawda said: “And there was Abu Yazid Suhayl ibn ʿAmr in a corner of the room, his hands tied to his neck with a rope.”

1a69a525a2.q: Whose protection did Abu al-ʿAs ibn al-Rabiʿ seek when a Muslim raiding party seized his goods?
c: Zaynab, daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ
1a69a525a2.e: Abu al-ʿAs came under cover of night to Zaynab, daughter of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and sought her protection, and she granted it.

31e34d581b.q: Why did the Prophet ﷺ withdraw his order to burn the two men if they were caught?
c: Because no one should punish with fire except Allah
31e34d581b.e: He ﷺ said: “I had ordered you to burn these two men … then I saw that no one should punish with fire except Allah.”

bdbef2db2d.q: Who was the only wife the Prophet ﷺ married who had not been married before, as Ibn ʿAbbas said?
bdbef2db2d.e: Ibn ʿAbbas said to ʿAʾisha: “The Prophet ﷺ married no virgin but you.”

1997f50fe4.q: How many times was the Prophet ﷺ shown ʿAʾisha in a dream before he married her?
1997f50fe4.e: The Prophet ﷺ said to ʿAʾisha: “You were shown to me in a dream twice; I saw you in a piece of silk.”

c25e85377b.q: Which Companion was protected by swarming bees (al-dabr) when he was killed at al-Rajiʿ?
c: ʿAsim ibn Thabit ibn Abi al-Aqlah
c25e85377b.e: ʿAsim ibn Thabit ibn Abi al-Aqlah al-Ansari, whom the bees protected when he was killed at al-Rajiʿ.

2b86964071.q: Who brought Safiyya bint Huyayy after the forts of Khaybar were taken?
2b86964071.e: Safiyya bint Huyayy and another woman were brought; Bilal, who brought them, led them past the Jewish dead.

9a198f26ba.q: What did the Prophet ﷺ do with Safiyya that let the Muslims know he had chosen her for himself?
c: He had her placed behind him and put his cloak over her
He freed her and sent her back to her people
He lodged her in Umm Sulaym's house
9a198f26ba.e: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had Safiyya placed behind him and put his cloak over her, so the Muslims knew he had chosen her for himself.

547fb84c7b.q: What dream did Safiyya see when she was the bride of Kinana ibn al-Rabiʿ?
c: That a moon fell into her lap
That a sun rose in her house
That a palm tree grew in her courtyard
That a bird carried off her ring
547fb84c7b.e: While the bride of Kinana ibn al-Rabiʿ, Safiyya dreamt that a moon fell into her lap, and her husband slapped her.

f524a749b9.q: When, by the agreement of the biographers, did the Prophet ﷺ begin writing to the kings of the world?
c: After al-Hudaybiya and before the Conquest of Makkah
f524a749b9.e: Ibn Kathir said: there is no disagreement among them that it began before the Conquest of Makkah and after al-Hudaybiya.
